lastResponse.text: I hear you, and I’m really glad you called. If they’re threatening you right now, call nine one one now. If you can, move toward a lit, public Place while you call. Keep your phone charged and stay where other people can see you. I can get a live person on the line next to help with a safe Place tonight, but first: are you in immediate danger right this second?
originalTexts: I hear you, and I’m really glad you called. If they’re threatening you right now, call 911 now. If you can, move toward a lit, public place while you call. Keep your phone charged and stay where other people can see you. I can get a live person on the line next to help with a safe place tonight, but first: are you in immediate danger right this second?
